reference_point.source: PC1 handoff-supplied NW foothill reference coordinate; independent geology citation not verified in this run

quality_note: NISAR L2 GUNW CRID P05023 provisional products only; calibration and validation are carried out by NASA-JPL/ISRO.
method_note: Headline value = most negative median of ~1 km blocks (13x13 px, >= 50 % valid pixels, within-block std <= 2 cm) of the cumulative LOS map. Rate = linear extrapolation of 120 days (2026-06-17 to 2026-10-15, summer season) to one year: an ESTIMATE that likely overstates the annual net rate because part of summer subsidence recovers in winter. Vertical value assumes purely vertical motion (LOS / cos(incidence)). range_cm = spread of the headline value when the whole chain is re-referenced to up to two other stable windows >= 30 km away.

reference_anchor.window: 7x7; at least 48/49 common-valid pixels; nearest high-coherence window within 3 km of source locality
